cognitive_contract.label: Model / non-routine modeling (Advanced Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Formulate governing mathematical equations or recurrence relations from non-routine verbal, physical, or algorithmic constraints to evaluate protected value W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to establish the formal mathematical model without intermediate prompt hinting or equation setup scaffolds.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the underlying physical, geometric, or combinatorial modeling principle without deriving the formal governing equation.

slots.X: the translation of binary sequence constraints into a coupled recurrence relation
slots.Y: binary transmissions of length n with no two consecutive zeros (00), a1 = 2, a2 = 3
slots.Z: state partition invariant: terminal digit 1 yields a_{n-1}, terminal digits 10 yield a_{n-2}; recurrence a_n = a_{n-1} + a_{n-2}
slots.wrong_idea: applying unconstrained binary powers 2^8 or off-by-one Fibonacci index slip evaluating a7 = 34
slots.replacement_rule: model valid endings into {Ends in 1} union {Ends in 10}; recurrence a_n = a_{n-1} + a_{n-2} yields a3=5, a4=8, a5=13, a6=21, a7=34, a8=55
slots.visual_job: render state transition decision tree showing terminal transitions to 1 and 10; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent check: generate all valid binary sequences of length 3 (010, 011, 101, 110, 111 -> 5) and length 4 (8 sequences), confirming a_n = a_{n-1} + a_{n-2}.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Rich verbal, physical, or computational problem context requiring mathematical formalization
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates modeling framework/partition; H2 derives governing intermediate relation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal model formulation with derivation and verification
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student modeling or indexing misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or numerical answers in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative modeling framework (e.g. matrix transfer state modeling instead of scalar recurrence)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical mathematical modeling requirement under modified parameters

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item extending the model to higher-dimensional or multi-agent constraints
